bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Wounded human commander; intimate, bitter and still proud
bosses.text: My vault... my blood. Take the rail, intruder. Let it remember who built this place.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Damaged machine warden; measured shutdown with power failing
bosses.text: Core failure. Warden protocol terminated. Forge cutter released. Do not let it cool.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.style: Infected specimen; breathless, predatory, almost human
bosses.text: You broke the cage. The toxin is yours now. Breathe carefully.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.style: Predictive machine core collapsing into static
bosses.text: Prediction failed. The Predictor rail is yours.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Dying reactor engineer, exhausted human rasp
bosses.text: Containment... lost. Take the Sink cannon. Seal the reactor.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Ancient memory custodian, calm synthetic voice breaking into human regret
bosses.text: Archive integrity lost. The rail is yours. Do not write me back.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.text: My vault is yours. I buried the truth beneath that rail. Do not let them seal it again.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.text: Safety locks have failed. My forge cutter is yours. Keep clear of the discharge.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.text: Containment was never meant to save you. The compound still lives in the sprayer.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.text: I saw every outcome except this one. The Predictor rifle is yours.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.text: Pressure gone. Take the Sink cannon. Keep the core from swallowing you.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.text: Last record: I was here. Take the Archive rail and carry it out.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.text: Coolant pressure collapsing. The Rime launcher is yours. Do not let it thaw.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.text: Containment ice gone. Keep the cold between you and the next chamber.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.text: Signal lost. The Relay carbine is unbound.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.text: No carrier. No command. Take my transmitter and make your own route.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.text: Hydraulics failed. Siege cannon released. The gate is yours.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.text: Load-bearing systems gone. Take the Titan cannon before the ceiling follows.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.text: You have cut the chain of command. The Kest rifle is yours.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.text: I built this place to outlast us. Take the rifle. Prove me wrong.

bosses.speaker: luna
bosses.style: Synthetic archivist shutting down with calm regret
bosses.text: Memory core erased. Take the Echo lance. Let the vault forget.

bosses.speaker: luna
bosses.style: Synthetic archivist shutting down with calm regret
bosses.text: This is my final memory. The Echo lance is yours. Carry it beyond these walls.
